table.name: city
table.purpose: World cities with their country, first-level administrative subdivision (state/province/region) and population. This is the classic MySQL 'world' sample database city table (ID, Name, CountryCode, District, Population).

col_001.name: id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique surrogate identifier for each city row (1..4079).

col_002.name: name
col_002.description: City name (e.g. 'Lubao', 'Matsumoto'). Not unique; some names repeat across countries.

col_003.name: country_code
col_003.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (CHN, IND, USA, ...), referencing the country table.

col_004.name: district
col_004.description: First-level administrative subdivision of the country the city is in (state/province/region), e.g. 'Central Luzon', 'Nagano', 'California'.

col_005.name: population
col_005.description: City population in persons; ranges from 42 to 10,500,000.

table.name: country
table.purpose: Reference table of world countries (one row per country), with geography, demographics, economy, and government attributes. This is the classic MySQL 'world' sample database's country table; it is referenced by city (country each city belongs to) and countrylanguage (country each language is spoken in).

col_001.name: country_code
col_001.description: Primary key: 3-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g. ABW=Aruba, GBR=United Kingdom, LAO=Laos). Referenced by city.col_003 and countrylanguage.col_001.

col_002.name: country_name
col_002.description: English name of the country (e.g. 'Afghanistan', 'Sierra Leone'). Unique per row.

col_003.name: continent
col_003.description: Continent the country belongs to; 7 values: Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, Oceania, Antarctica.

col_004.name: region
col_004.description: Sub-continental region within the continent (e.g. 'Caribbean', 'Eastern Africa', 'Southeast Asia', 'Western Africa').

col_005.name: surface_area_km2
col_005.description: Land area of the country in square kilometers (range 0.4 to 17,075,400; e.g. Laos 236,800, Sierra Leone 71,740).

col_006.name: independence_year
col_006.description: Year the country gained independence (e.g. 1960, 1991, 1776 for USA). Null for territories that are not independent (e.g. British Indian Ocean Territory). The negative minimum (-1523) is odd and may be a data artifact (e.g. an ancient date encoded oddly); the join to city.col_001 is spurious.

col_007.name: population
col_007.description: Country population in persons (range 0 to ~1.28 billion; e.g. Laos 5,433,000, Sierra Leone 4,854,000).

col_008.name: life_expectancy_years
col_008.description: Average life expectancy in years (range 37.2–83.5, mean ~66.5; e.g. Laos 53.1, Sierra Leone 45.3). Null for uninhabited/unknown territories.

col_009.name: gnp
col_009.description: Gross National Product, in millions of US dollars (e.g. Laos 1292, Sierra Leone 746; 0 for territories without an economy).

col_010.name: gnp_old
col_010.description: Older/previous GNP figure, in millions of US dollars, same magnitude as col_009 (e.g. Laos 1746 vs current 1292). Null for ~25% of rows. Exact vintage (previous year vs older source) is not determinable from the data; no joins provide further evidence.

col_011.name: local_name
col_011.description: Country name in local language(s) or non-English form (e.g. 'Afganistan/Afqanestan', 'Al-Jaza'ir/Algérie', 'Lao').

col_012.name: government_form
col_012.description: Form of government (e.g. 'Republic', 'Constitutional Monarchy', 'Dependent Territory of the UK', 'Monarchy (Sultanate)').

col_013.name: head_of_state
col_013.description: Name of the head of state (e.g. 'Elisabeth II' for Commonwealth realms, 'Jacques Chirac', 'Khamtay Siphandone'). Data reflects ~2000-2005 era.

col_014.name: capital_city_id
col_014.description: Foreign key to city.col_001 identifying the country's capital city (one-to-one join accepted by statistics; null for territories without a capital).

col_015.name: iso_code_2
col_015.description: 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'LA' for Laos, 'SL' for Sierra Leone, 'IO' for British Indian Ocean Territory).

table.name: countrylanguage
table.purpose: Languages spoken in each country: one row per (country, language) pair, with whether the language is official and the percentage of the population speaking it. Classic MySQL 'world' sample database table.

col_001.name: country_code
col_001.description: ISO 3-letter country code (e.g. IND, USA, CAN), referencing country.col_001; many languages per country.

col_002.name: language
col_002.description: Name of the language spoken in the country (e.g. Urdu, English, Creole English).

col_003.name: is_official
col_003.description: Whether the language is official in the country: 'T' = true (official), 'F' = false (not official).

col_004.name: percentage
col_004.description: Percentage (0-100) of the country's population that speaks the language; 100.0 means the whole population.
